queries.title: Search Queries
queries.description: Keywords, company names, or IPC/CPC codes (e.g. 'quantum computing', 'Google AI', 'G06F')

date_from.title: Date From
date_from.description: Only return patents filed/published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

max_results.title: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum total patents to return (across all queries and jurisdictions)

embeddings.title: Generate Embeddings
embeddings.description: If enabled, each patent gets a 384-dimensional semantic embedding (all-MiniLM-L6-v2). Slows run by ~1min/1000 patents.

webhook_url.title: Webhook URL
webhook_url.description: Optional. A POST request with run summary is sent here on completion.
